task_instruction: Finish the card dragging mechanic for the alternate harness. The provided `res://scenes/main.tscn` harness keeps three `CardUI` instances under `ScreenUI/Grip`, and each card should continue using the existing `CardStateMachine`, `CardBaseState`, `CardClickedState`, and `CardDraggingState` nodes from `res://scenes/card_ui/card_ui.tscn`. In `res://scenes/card_ui/card_state_machine.gd`, initialize every child state, connect each state's `transition_requested` signal, enter the exported `initial_state`, and forward `_input` and `gui_input` to the active state while ignoring transition requests that do not come from the current state. In `res://scenes/card_ui/card_ui.gd`, call `card_state_machine.init(self)` in `_ready()`, forward the existing input callbacks into the state machine, and keep `targets` updated from the `DropPointDetector` area enter/exit callbacks without duplicates. In the card state scripts, make the base state emit `reparent_requested`, reset `DropPointDetector.monitoring` to `false`, and move to the clicked state on left-click, make the clicked state record `original_index`, enable `DropPointDetector.monitoring`, and transition to dragging on mouse motion, make the dragging state reparent the card into the node in the `drag_layer` group, follow the mouse, cancel back to base on right-click, and only confirm release after `DRAG_MINIMUM_THRESHOLD := 0.06` has elapsed, and make the released state immediately remove the card when `targets` is not empty but otherwise go back to base on the next input. In `res://scenes/ui/hand.gd`, connect each new card's `reparent_requested` signal and restore cancelled drags back into `Grip` at their recorded index.

@@ -1,3 +1,30 @@
 extends "res://scenes/card_ui/card_states/card_state.gd"
 
 const DRAG_MINIMUM_THRESHOLD := 0.06
+
+var elapsed := 0.0
+var mouse_offset := Vector2.ZERO
+
+
+func enter() -> void:
+	elapsed = 0.0
+	mouse_offset = card_ui.get_global_mouse_position() - card_ui.global_position
+	var drag_layer := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("drag_layer")
+	if drag_layer:
+		card_ui.reparent(drag_layer)
+	card_ui.drop_point_detector.monitoring = true
+	card_ui.global_position = card_ui.get_global_mouse_position() - mouse_offset
+
+
+func on_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if event.is_action_pressed("right_mouse"):
+		transition_requested.emit(self, CardState.State.BASE)
+	elif event.is_action_released("left_mouse") and elapsed >= DRAG_MINIMUM_THRESHOLD:
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+		transition_requested.emit(self, CardState.State.RELEASED)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if card_ui.card_state_machine.current_state == self:
+		elapsed += delta
+		card_ui.global_position = card_ui.get_global_mouse_position() - mouse_offset

+extends SceneTree
+
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	call_deferred("run")
+
+
+func action_event(action: StringName, pressed: bool) -> InputEventAction:
+	var event := InputEventAction.new()
+	event.action = action
+	event.pressed = pressed
+	return event
+
+
+func run() -> void:
+	var main = load("res://scenes/main.tscn").instantiate()
+	root.add_child(main)
+	await process_frame
+
+	var grip := main.get_node("ScreenUI/Grip")
+	assert(grip.get_child_count() == 3)
+	var card = grip.get_child(1)
+	assert(card.card_state_machine.current_state.state == CardState.State.BASE)
+	assert(not card.drop_point_detector.monitoring)
+
+	card._on_gui_input(action_event("left_mouse", true))
+	assert(card.card_state_machine.current_state.state == CardState.State.CLICKED)
+	assert(card.original_index == 1)
+	assert(card.drop_point_detector.monitoring)
+	card._input(InputEventMouseMotion.new())
+	assert(card.card_state_machine.current_state.state == CardState.State.DRAGGING)
+	assert(card.get_parent().is_in_group("drag_layer"))
+	card._input(action_event("right_mouse", true))
+	assert(card.card_state_machine.current_state.state == CardState.State.BASE)
+	assert(card.get_parent() == grip)
+	assert(card.get_index() == 1)
+
+	card._on_gui_input(action_event("left_mouse", true))
+	card._input(InputEventMouseMotion.new())
+	card._on_drop_point_detector_area_entered(main.get_node("CastZone"))
+	card._on_drop_point_detector_area_entered(main.get_node("CastZone"))
+	assert(card.targets.size() == 1)
+	card._on_drop_point_detector_area_exited(main.get_node("CastZone"))
+	assert(card.targets.is_empty())
+	await create_timer(0.07).timeout
+	card._input(action_event("left_mouse", false))
+	assert(card.card_state_machine.current_state.state == CardState.State.RELEASED)
+	card._input(InputEventMouseMotion.new())
+	assert(card.card_state_machine.current_state.state == CardState.State.BASE)
+	assert(card.get_parent() == grip)
+	assert(card.get_index() == 1)
+
+	card._on_gui_input(action_event("left_mouse", true))
+	card._input(InputEventMouseMotion.new())
+	card._on_drop_point_detector_area_entered(main.get_node("CastZone"))
+	await create_timer(0.07).timeout
+	card._input(action_event("left_mouse", false))
+	await process_frame
+	assert(not is_instance_valid(card))
+	assert(grip.get_child_count() == 2)
+
+	print("drag mechanic test passed")
+	quit()
